message:
fix(host): the punch queue lives one Start..Stop (keepalive-r2 FINDING r2, Codex codex_ka_punch_thread_src_r1.md N1)

Codex (its isolated test x3): Stop / Start did not empty punchJobs_ -- after a Stop mid-train one job with 24 punches
left stayed, and the restarted thread sent the old target with its old host proof. And the cycle (the producer) may
push after the punch thread left.

Now Stop discards the queue only after BOTH threads ended (the cycle and the punch thread); Punch() queues nothing
once the agent is stopping; Start begins with an empty queue (a belt behind Stop's clear).

remote60_host_agent_punch_test (the real HostAgent Start / Punch / Stop with its punch thread, an unreachable
directory, a recording send): 9/9 x3 -- a Stop mid-train leaves no job and nothing more goes out; a Punch while
stopped queues nothing; the next Start never sends the old target or its proof, its own train goes out. Mutants: Stop
keeps the queue -> 3 FAIL; Punch queues while stopped -> 1 FAIL; Start keeps the queue -> survives (Stop's clear
covers it: the belt). Test-only hooks under REMOTE60_HOST_AGENT_TEST_HOOKS (that test's target only).
